import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a = new int[32][32];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(a[i], 0);
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix b, int k) {
            Matrix c = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l <= k; l++) {
                        c.a[i][l] = (int) ((c.a[i][l] + (long) a[i][j] * b.a[j][l]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
            return c;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        List<Integer> q = new ArrayList<>();
        while (n > 0) {
            q.add((int) (n % k));
            n /= k;
        }
        Collections.reverse(q);

        int size = q.size();

        Matrix[][] f = new Matrix[size + 1][k + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                f[i][j] = new Matrix();
            }
        }

        // Initialize identity matrix
        Matrix identity = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                if (i == j || i == 0 || j == 0) {
                    identity.a[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                f[i + 1][j] = new Matrix();
                // Copy identity
                for (int r = 0; r <= k; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(identity.a[r], 0, f[i + 1][j].a[r], 0, k + 1);
                }
                f[i + 1][j].a[j][j] = 1;
                f[i + 1][j].a[0][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix[] pre = new Matrix[size + 1];
        Matrix[] suf = new Matrix[size + 1];

        pre[0] = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            pre[0].a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        suf[size] = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            suf[size].a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
            pre[i] = pre[i - 1].multiply(f[i][0], k);
        }
        for (int i = size - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            suf[i] = f[i + 1][0].multiply(suf[i + 1], k);
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        ans.a[0][k] = 1;
        int sum = 0;

        for (int i = size - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < q.get(i); j++) {
                ans = ans.multiply(f[i + 1][(sum + j) % k], k);
            }
            sum = (sum + q.get(i)) % MOD;
        }

        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            result = (result + ans.a[0][i]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
